name: io.github.dylantirandaz/tailscale-compute
title: Tailscale Compute
description: Run builds, tests, and benchmarks on your own Tailscale compute node.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH user and direct Tailscale IP address or full MagicDNS name.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_LOCAL_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute local project path. The default is the MCP process directory.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_REMOTE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Managed workspace root on the remote node. The default is .cache/tailscale-compute-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: SSH connection timeout from 1 through 60 seconds.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS
environmentVariables.description: Optional node-wide active job limit from 1 through 1024.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_COMPUTE_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Local audit log path. The default is ~/.config/tailscale-compute-mcp/compute-audit.log.
